title: Checklist Design
brief: An AI-powered design review tool: run a UX/UI quality check on any screen and get instant analysis of what's working, what's missing, and what to improve. It also hosts a searchable library of design checklists covering websites, web apps, mobile, components, and flows, plus a Figma plugin for in-canvas reviews.
details: Checklist Design offers 129 browsable design checklists covering mobile apps, web apps, websites, design systems, and user flows — from onboarding and paywalls to buttons, modals, empty states, and cancel-subscription flows. Each checklist breaks a screen or flow into the concrete details worth verifying before shipping. The checklists are also packaged as an agent skill and a Figma skill, so the same guidance can run inside AI coding assistants and design tools.
